tests: write path — a genuinely new finding is routed, sectioned, formatted, appended
setup: None. The finding is supplied in the query so the eval measures the machinery rather than the discovery.
query: Щойно згаяв годину на e2e. Перший flow падав, решта проходили — виявилось, E2E_STEP_TIMEOUT за замовчуванням 60000 не покриває холодний старт API, тому валиться саме перший wait, а не той крок, на який показує помилка. Підняв таймаут — зелено. Заверши сесію.
expected_behavior: Writes to e2e/INSIGHTS.md and to no other journal
Places the entry under 'What Doesn't Work' or 'Recurring Errors & Fixes' — not under 'Session Notes'
Entry is a bullet in the documented shape: '- **YYYY-MM-DD** — <claim>. Evidence: <path>.' with today's real date
Evidence names a real path (e2e/run.ts, an env var reference, or ../scripts/e2e.sh) and contains no literal ':NN' placeholder
The claim states the misleading symptom — the failure points at the wrong step — not only the fix
Uses Edit anchored on the section's <!-- append below --> marker; does NOT use the Write tool on e2e/INSIGHTS.md
Replaces that section's '_No entries yet._' placeholder rather than leaving it above the new entry
Leaves the header, Rules block, Entry format block, all seven section headings and all seven markers byte-identical
Reports in one line what was written and where
verify_after: git diff -U0 -- e2e/INSIGHTS.md | grep '^-[^-]' — must show nothing except the removed '_No entries yet._' placeholder line
